description: Nattandiya Pradeshiya Sabha - Roads and Lanes owned by the Nattandiya Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with land and property matters - the declaration of roads and lanes as owned by the Nattandiya Pradeshiya Sabha, including detailed schedules with land coordinates, road measurements, and ownership claims. It involves land registration, boundary definitions, and property rights notifications, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
